name: secondary_enrollment
genetic_identity: Secondary enrollment is participation in secondary schooling as measured by enrollment rates — an access/participation concept, not completion of a level.
description: Suspected/related concept often silently substituted for secondary completion. Kept explicit so undirected analysis can be shown to leave the completion concept when it uses SE.SEC.ENRR as success.

atoms.name: is_participation_measure
atoms.statement: Secondary enrollment measures participation in secondary school, not finishing it.

atoms.name: binds_to_gross_enrollment
atoms.statement: Within WDI, the primary series is school enrollment, secondary (% gross), SE.SEC.ENRR.

atoms.name: gross_rate_may_exceed_100
atoms.statement: Gross enrollment may exceed 100% due to over-age students and repeaters; that is still enrollment, not completion.

atoms.name: is_country_year_evaluable
atoms.statement: Enrollment is evaluable when SE.SEC.ENRR is non-null for the country-year.

rules.name: must_not_claim_completion
rules.statement: Using this concept's series to claim secondary completion success leaves this concept and invades secondary_completion without warrant.

holds_within: National WDI 2010–2023 country-year gross secondary enrollment
breaks_at: Net enrollment only series without gross

relations.note: Must not be substituted for completion.

glossary.gross_enrollment: Enrollment of all ages in a level as a percentage of the official age group for that level.
